root_cause: Existing 04:20 UTC Content growth learning workflow checked only truthiness of daily_performance_diagnostics.source_state. States AUTH_REQUIRED, SOURCE_ERROR or NOT_COLLECTED are truthy, so no provider data can produce a green daily learning artifact.
fix: Add deterministic pure provider-truth validator and tests within existing scheduled growth workflow. Require READ_ONLY_PROVIDER_OBSERVED with at least one actual social post and source-quality row before treating the daily provider learning as evidence-backed. Always preserve bounded diagnostic artifacts even when authentication or provider readback fails.
prevention_rule: Do not turn missing provider credentials, empty observations, stale or errored readback into a successful growth learning evaluation; retain truthfully classified evidence and allow existing canonical recovery ownership. No duplicate scheduler, provider fallback, synthetic likes/impressions, lead or revenue assertions.
terminal_rule: Required+CodeQL exact-head green, protected merge, next scheduled daily artifact with independent authenticated source and nonempty brand observations; green GitHub YAML is not real live metric coverage.
